scenario.name: AirNow AQI Daily Report
scenario.description: Fetches current air quality observations from AirNow once daily and formats a structured AQI report. Requires credentials: airnow_api_key, home_latitude, home_longitude (shared with Pirate Weather if already set).

agents.name: Fetch AirNow Current AQI
agents.description: Calls the AirNow observation API for the configured location. Free API key at airnowapi.org. Reuses home_latitude and home_longitude credentials from Pirate Weather if already created. distance=25 searches within 25 miles.

agents.name: Format AQI Report
agents.description: Formats the AirNow array response into a structured event. AQI categories: 0-50 Good, 51-100 Moderate, 101-150 Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups, 151-200 Unhealthy, 201-300 Very Unhealthy, 301+ Hazardous. Note: AirNow DateObserved has a trailing space — the trim filter handles it.

templates.overall_aqi: {%- set ns = namespace(aqi=0, cat="") -%}{%- for obs in response_json -%}{%- if obs.AQI > ns.aqi -%}{%- set ns.aqi = obs.AQI -%}{%- set ns.cat = obs.Category.Name -%}{%- endif -%}{%- endfor -%}{{ ns.aqi }}
templates.overall_category: {%- set ns = namespace(aqi=0, cat="") -%}{%- for obs in response_json -%}{%- if obs.AQI > ns.aqi -%}{%- set ns.aqi = obs.AQI -%}{%- set ns.cat = obs.Category.Name -%}{%- endif -%}{%- endfor -%}{{ ns.cat }}
templates.pollutants: {%- for obs in response_json -%}{{ obs.ParameterName }}: {{ obs.AQI }} ({{ obs.Category.Name }}){% if not loop.last %}, {% endif %}{%- endfor -%}
templates.pm25_aqi: {%- set ns = namespace(v="N/A") -%}{%- for obs in response_json -%}{%- if obs.ParameterName == "PM2.5" -%}{%- set ns.v = obs.AQI | string -%}{%- endif -%}{%- endfor -%}{{ ns.v }}
templates.o3_aqi: {%- set ns = namespace(v="N/A") -%}{%- for obs in response_json -%}{%- if obs.ParameterName == "O3" -%}{%- set ns.v = obs.AQI | string -%}{%- endif -%}{%- endfor -%}{{ ns.v }}
templates.health_guidance: {%- set ns = namespace(aqi=0) -%}{%- for obs in response_json -%}{%- if obs.AQI > ns.aqi -%}{%- set ns.aqi = obs.AQI -%}{%- endif -%}{%- endfor -%}{%- set a = ns.aqi -%}{%- if a <= 50 -%}Air quality is good. No precautions needed.{%- elif a <= 100 -%}Unusually sensitive people should consider reducing prolonged outdoor exertion.{%- elif a <= 150 -%}Sensitive groups should reduce prolonged outdoor exertion. Others are unlikely to be affected.{%- elif a <= 200 -%}Everyone should reduce prolonged outdoor exertion. Sensitive groups should avoid outdoor activity.{%- elif a <= 300 -%}Everyone should avoid prolonged outdoor exertion. Sensitive groups should remain indoors.{%- else -%}Everyone should avoid all outdoor exertion. Sensitive groups should remain indoors.{%- endif -%}
